_guide: Video sources for scripts/video_daily.py. Every 'row' is a topic (one row on the screen); earlier rows show first. channels: YouTube handles (the @name on the channel page, without @); the script looks up their newest uploads. queries: search phrases, a few are used each day in rotation (every search costs 100 of the 10,000 free YouTube units per day). weight: rows with a bigger number get more new videos per day. Videos are never removed from the catalog.
